failing_checks.title: Stated purpose versus behaviour
failing_checks.reason: The stated purpose is a client IP allowlist on API keys. extractClientIP (line 157) takes the client address from the X-Forwarded-For or X-Real-IP header before RemoteAddr, and both headers are set by the caller.
